drivingQuestion: When do berries outnumbering the leaves disqualify the myrtle?
outcomeNote: the corrected version of Rav's dictum stands, extended to red berries

segments.he: שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשָׁה מְקוֹמוֹת הָוֵי מְנוּמָּר, וּפְסוּל.
segments.en: If the berries are distributed in «two or three places,» the myrtle branch «is speckled» with different colors in different places. It lacks beauty «and is» certainly «unfit.»

segments.he: אֶלָּא, אִי אִתְּמַר הָכִי אִתְּמַר: אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ עֲנָבָיו מְרוּבִּין מֵעָלָיו — פָּסוּל. אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: דָּבָר זֶה רַבֵּינוּ הַגָּדוֹל אֲמָרוֹ, וְהַמָּקוֹם יִהְיֶה בְּעֶזְרוֹ: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא עֲנָבָיו שְׁחוֹרוֹת. אֲבָל עֲנָבָיו יְרוּקּוֹת — מִינֵי דַהֲדַס הוּא, וְכָשֵׁר.
segments.en: «Rather,» emend the text: «If» this statement «was stated, it was stated as follows: Or,» if «its berries were more numerous» than its leaves, it is «unfit. Rav Ḥisda said: This statement was stated by our great rabbi,» Rav, «and may the Omnipresent» come «to his assistance:» The Sages «taught» this halakha «only» with regard to ripe, «black berries,» since they stand in stark contrast to the green leaves of the branch, which then appears speckled. «However, if its berries are green,» they «are» considered of «the» same «type as» the «myrtle branch,» as they are the same color. Consequently, the branch does not appear speckled, «and» therefore «it is fit.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַב פָּפָּא: אֲדוּמּוֹת כִּשְׁחוֹרוֹת דָּמְיָין, דְּאָמַר רַבִּי חֲנִינָא: הַאי דָּם שָׁחוֹר — אָדוֹם הוּא, אֶלָּא שֶׁלָּקָה.
segments.en: «Rav Pappa said:» The legal status of «red» berries «is like» that of «black» ones, «as Rabbi Ḥanina said:» In the case of menstrual blood, «this black blood is» actually «red» blood, «except that it deteriorated.» Red and black are considered two shades of the same color.
